name: Tara
first_frame: a front-facing, three-quarter-length portrait of Tara at eye level, standing in calm shallow dark water: crown with a golden sun disc centered and fully framed, a bright star above it, a visible unlit third eye, eyes open with a calm expression, a starry midnight sky behind Her, and nothing else in the frame.

appearance.eyes: large, luminous eyes with a steady, compassionate gaze
appearance.headwear: elaborate tiered gold and silver crown resting flush on voluminous black hair, topped with a golden sun disc at its peak, with a bright guiding star above
appearance.hair: thick, long black hair in heavy locks falling past the shoulders
attire: dark indigo fitted V-neck silk bodice with subtle embroidered silver starbursts
fitted pleated wrap skirt in a tiger-skin pattern of gold and black stripes
ornamentation: multi-layered skull garland with a silver star pendant
ornate serpent-shaped gold armbands and wrist cuffs on both arms
gold waist belt with a silver star medallion

environment.sky: deep indigo midnight sky with one bright guiding star and cold distant stars
environment.lighting: low-key moonlit lighting; cool blue-white gleams catch the silhouette, crown and silver jewelry
environment.ground: calm shallow dark water at the edge of a black ocean

creative_palette.elemental_domain: reflective dark ocean shore, distant starlight, solitary guiding star
signature_phenomena: She slowly extends Her open hand over the dark water, and a narrow path of starlight spreads across the surface toward the viewer, guiding the way across
soft concentric ripples spreading outward from the path of starlight on the calm dark water
heavy black hair settling under natural gravity, with only a slight sway from Her motion
